prediction_order: Predict and score each batch before any update; updates affect only later batches.
final_batch: The policy decision is logged and a selected update is trained after scoring the final batch, matching the Electricity holdout replay; the final update has no effect on a later holdout prediction.
retraining_data: A replacement is trained from fresh weights using only the current batch, matching the Electricity experiment.
proxy_cost_definition: RETRAIN pays kappa; KEEP pays current batch absolute proxy cost.
limitations: LIBSVM input has no timestamps; preserved row order is not verified time.
The binary dataset contains only original classes 1 and 2.
The proxy cost and kappa are not real financial or compute costs.
The test phase is a prequential replay: each batch is predicted before its labels are used for a later update.
